learn.readTheCandleUnderstandTheRange: Read the candle, understand the range
learn.aCandlestickSummarizesAnIntervalOpenHigh: A candlestick summarizes an interval: open, high, low and close. Its body runs from open to close; the wicks show the extremes. Volume counts the base asset traded. A forming candle can still change. Compare completed candles over consistent intervals, and remember that a pattern is an observation, not a guarantee.
learn.utcKeepsDailyBoundariesConsistentOneCale: UTC keeps daily boundaries consistent. One calendar month (1M) is different from thirty days; a one-day candle is different from a rolling 24-hour ticker.
learn.knowWhatYourPortfolioActuallyEarned: Know what your portfolio actually earned
learn.weightedAverageCostDividesTheRemainingPu: Weighted average cost divides the remaining purchase cost, including buy fees, by the remaining units. A sale removes units at that average cost. Realized profit is sale proceeds minus sell fees and the cost of units sold. Unrealized profit compares the value of open holdings with their remaining cost.
learn.exampleBuy2UnitsAt100And: Example: buy 2 units at 100 and 1 at 160. Cost is 360; average is 120. Sell 1 at 150: realized profit is 30 before fees, remaining cost is 240. Sale proceeds do not reduce average purchase cost.
learn.treatABacktestAsAQuestion: Treat a backtest as a question
learn.aModelMustBeTestedOnData: A model must be tested on data it has never seen. Splitting randomly can leak the future into the past. Fit transformations on training data only, compare against a simple baseline and report weak results as honestly as strong ones. Historical accuracy does not establish future reliability.
learn.directionAndPriceErrorAnswerDifferentQue: Direction and price error answer different questions. A strategy also needs spread, fees, slippage and a feasible execution time. This demo publishes no trading strategy or reliable forecasting claim.
learn.youBuy2UnitsAt100Usdt: You buy 2 units at 100 USDT and 1 at 160 USDT. What is your average cost before fees?
learn.totalCostIs360UsdtDividedBy: Total cost is 360 USDT divided by 3 units: 120 USDT. Weight each purchase by quantity.
learn.theFormingCandleContinuesToIncorporateTr: The forming candle continues to incorporate trades until its close time. Completed candles are used by the research pipeline.
learn.whatIsTheSafestWayToEvaluate: What is the safest way to evaluate a one-day forecasting model?
